cells.gaps: No source found says the Direct Social Aid system pays beneficiaries through banks or mobile money, or that one system serves two or more programmes.
cells.note: The ANSS annual report, per Le Brief, has the Direct Social Aid programme supporting 3.9 million households at end-2025 on management information systems run by CNSS and CNRA and being migrated to the ANSS. Nothing held says how payments reach beneficiaries, so not 4.
